item.title: Review: THE TESTEMENT OF ANN LEE is a Mesmerizing Leap of Faith That Took Me By Surprise
item.description: The Testament of Ann Lee is one of those films that caught me off guard. I went in knowing almost nothing about the Shakers, and honestly, it’s not a slice of history I’d ever gone out of my way to explore. What I got instead was a deeply absorbing period film that pulled me in fast and didn’t let go.
